definitions: To push something or someone suddenly and with a lot of force.
To make a sudden forward movement with a part of your body, especially your hand or arm.
To push a knife or other pointed object into something or someone.
To force someone or something into a particular situation or position.
To propel (a boat, vehicle, or aircraft) in a specified direction.
examples: He thrust the letter into her hand.
She thrust her chin forward defiantly.
The knight thrust his sword into the dragon.
He was thrust into a position of leadership.
The engines thrust the rocket skyward.
